definition: PolyAnalyst is a data science software platform developed by Megaputer Intelligence that provides an environment for text mining, data mining, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
details: It is used by Megaputer to build tools with applications to health care, business management, insurance, and other industries. PolyAnalyst has also been used for COVID-19 forecasting and scientific research.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is PolyAnalyst.
